title: Natural harmonics at the twelfth fret
description: Two half notes: the octave harmonics of the open low E and A strings. MNX pitch is sounding, so each note stores what is heard (E3, A3) and the derivation ladder places it — string 6 and string 5 at fret 12, which for the octave node is also where the finger touches, so the tab digits read as a player expects. harmonic.type distinguishes natural from artificial/pinch/tap/semi/feedback; artificial harmonics (where the touching fret is not the sounding position) are deliberately left to a later scenario once the renderer can mark them. MusicXML's harmonic model is a known redesign candidate (w3c-cg/mnx#179). The renderer does not draw harmonic marks yet; the goldens pin the derived 12s.
